full_run_82.note: The 82-scenario full run is documented in the narrative but its per-scenario results are not stored as machine-readable data. This script reconciles the narrative counts with the quick-subset machine data to produce a canonical output. A future version should persist the full-run per-scenario results to data/extrapolation_stress_full.json.

provenance.recomputation_note: This script reconciles historical artifacts rather than re-running 82 GP fits from scratch. To truly recompute, run the full extrapolation pipeline via scripts/run_*.py for each scenario and re-aggregate. The SimplexUQ reproducibility bar requires persisting per-scenario machine-readable outputs, which this script does for the 18-scenario quick subset.
